title: Question word or if/whether?
instructions: Does the question have a **question word**? Or is it a **yes/no question**? Choose the right word for the reported question.
hint: Question word → keep it. Yes/no question → **if** or **whether**.

items.question: Diego asked Mila ___ she was tired.
Sofia wanted to know ___ Mila liked pancakes.

items.direct: Aisha to Tyler: "Why are you laughing?"
items.question: Aisha asked Tyler ___ he was laughing.

items.direct: Mrs Moreno to Mila: "Have you called your parents?"
items.question: Mrs Moreno asked Mila ___ she had called her parents.
Tyler wanted to know ___ the game started.

items.direct: Mr Okafor to Mila: "Which club would you like to join?"
items.question: Mr Okafor asked Mila ___ club she would like to join.
Mila asked ___ she could sit there.
